items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: we would sit there until 8:00, 9:00 and 10:00 in the morning, listening to Art Tatum play.

ctx.x: I've heard records -- he played similarly to Earl.

Right, right, right, right, and he was one of the competitors for Earl at that particular time. So -- locally, and then later on when Art Tatum came here in the '30s down to the Three Deuces, so that --
